entities.name: Anatoly Ufimtsev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anatoly Gavrilovich Ufimtsev was a Soviet and Kazakh chess player and economist. The Ufimtsev Defense is named after him. He holds the record for the most Kazakhstani Chess Championship wins with eleven.
